parole.significato: a small hut with walls out of turf or earth, formerly used by Sami nomads in northern Norway
parole.testo: Borrowed from Norwegian Nynorsk gamme, from Old Norse gammi. Cognate to Elfdalian gamme (“protruding part of a roof”).

parole.testo: Compound of härska (“rule; reign”) + teknik (“technique”). Borrowed from Norwegian Nynorsk hersketeknikk, coined by Norwegian psychologist Ingjald Nissen in 1945. First attested in 1980.
